verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe's docs serve an llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-directed guidance. Stripe Tax pages are also available as clean markdown (e.g. tax.md, standalone-tax-api.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable Tax documentation. Missing for 10: confirmation that the Stripe-wide llms.txt indexes the Tax-specific pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
